text:
Maya (Partnerships): heads-up: LlamaIndex wants a joint quickstart bundling their indexer + our gateway + a sample orchestrator hook for marketplace. they asked for a 30-min sandbox run and a one-page install guide. cc @Owen @Li

Owen (Eng): we can support. key asks: webhook callback with HMAC, example index ingestion flow, and a small local dev compose. will prepare a minimal example.

Li (Infra): for marketplace manifests we need `bundle_id` and a permission-map. recommending `bundle_id=llindex-gateway-2026`. staging tenant ready in 48h.

Sam (Solutions): partner requests an orchestration sample that shows retry/backoff for failed indexing jobs. i can add a node/python snippet and a postmortem example.

Owen (Eng): draft docker-compose for quickstart:
```
version: '3'
services:
  gateway:
    image: redwood/gateway:canary
    environment:
      REDWOOD_TENANT=llindex-sandbox
      BUNDLE_ID=llindex-gateway-2026
      WEBHOOK_SECRET=replace_me
    ports: ["8080:8080"]
```

Owen (Eng): curl to register indexer:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/api/v1/connectors \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"name":"llindex","callback":"https://ll.example.com/cb"}'
```

Li (Infra): deploy-bot: staging bundle tag applied to tenant llindex-sandbox at 2026-03-10T14:05:12Z.

Maya (Partnerships): great — let's finalize the one-pager + smoke-test script by EOD Tue so marketing can prep assets. I'll schedule sandbox run for Thu.

Sam (Solutions): noted. i'll add malformed-callback tests and a retry matrix to the smoke-test.

Owen (Eng): i'll open the quickstart PR shortly.

Maya (Partnerships): thanks team!
